description: Spatially modeled Victorian Rainfall Deficit map. This visualization uses distance-weighted interpolation (Inverse Distance Weighting) derived from Bureau of Meteorology regional hub data to provide a continuous regional climate field.
source: Bureau of Meteorology (Hub Data) + Spatial Modeling
citation: Bureau of Meteorology. (2026). Climate Data Online: Rainfall Deciles. Spatially interpolated for regional resolution by D. Sharma (2026).
